body:
## Nebulaphobia
*An entity within the fog watches your every move. Watch your back, or it'll get you.*

## Features
- A brand-new model inspired by [Enhanced Cave Noise.jar](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enhanced-cave-noise-jar)
- Escapable chases (playable in survival)
- A challenging opponent to fight
- Smart behavior
- Nerve wracking sound design

## Installation
Simply place the `.jar` file of the mod along with it's required dependencies into your `mods/` directory.\
This mod has to be installed on both client and server side.
